key: RADOMUS: So you were in this kind of place...
en: RADOMUS: So you were in this kind of place...
ja: ラドマス: こんな場所にいたのか…

key: Just as well.
en: Just as well.
ja: それでいい。

key: Gardevoir, it's me.
en: Gardevoir, it's me.
ja: サーナイト、私だ。

key: RADOMUS: I know.
en: RADOMUS: I know.
ja: ラドマス: わかっている。

key: Everything will be quite all right, my dear.
en: Everything will be quite all right, my dear.
ja: すべて大丈夫だ、愛しい人。

key: Just come to me, and we can quit this place.
en: Just come to me, and we can quit this place.
ja: 私のところへ来てくれれば、ここを出られる。

key: As before, we can leave everything behind.
en: As before, we can leave everything behind.
ja: 以前と同じように、すべてを置いて去ることができる。

key: It will be over soon enough regardless.
en: It will be over soon enough regardless.
ja: いずれにせよ、まもなく終わる。

key: Won't you stay with me?
en: Won't you stay with me?
ja: 私のそばにいてくれないか?

key: RADOMUS: There you go, moondrop.
en: RADOMUS: There you go, moondrop.
ja: ラドマス: そうだ、それでいい、月のしずく。

key: Everything is okay.
en: Everything is okay.
ja: すべて大丈夫だ。

key: RADOMUS: You can't communicate anymore, can you?
en: RADOMUS: You can't communicate anymore, can you?
ja: ラドマス: もう意思を伝えられないのだな?

key: Just what have they...
en: Just what have they...
ja: 一体、奴らは何を…

key: Or rather, what has she done to you...
en: Or rather, what has she done to you...
ja: いや、彼女は貴様に何をしたのだ…

key: It was always supposed to be better than this.
en: It was always supposed to be better than this.
ja: 本来、こんなことにはならないはずだった。

key: I'm so sorry, Zina...
en: I'm so sorry, Zina...
ja: 本当にすまない、ジーナ…

key: RADOMUS: A-ah, I see...
en: RADOMUS: A-ah, I see...
ja: ラドマス: あ、ああ、そうか…

key: My darling,
en: My darling,
ja: 愛しい人、

key: I'm so, so s--
en: I'm so, so s--
ja: 本当に、本当にす――

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が結晶に反応した!

key: ...But nothing happened?
en: ...But nothing happened?
ja: …でも、何も起こらなかった?

key: LUNA: To those who are afraid of the dark,
en: LUNA: To those who are afraid of the dark,
ja: ルナ: 闇を恐れる者たちへ、

key: You are wrong.
en: You are wrong.
ja: あなたたちは間違っている。

key: It is not the darkness you fear.
en: It is not the darkness you fear.
ja: あなたたちが恐れているのは、闇そのものではない。

key: It is the feelings you have within it.
en: It is the feelings you have within it.
ja: 闇の中で抱く、その感情なのだ。

key: Whether that is loneliness,
en: Whether that is loneliness,
ja: それが孤独であれ、

key: The uncertainty of not knowing what could lie just beyond your reach,
en: The uncertainty of not knowing what could lie just beyond your reach,
ja: 手の届く先に何があるかわからない不安であれ、

key: Or the misery of being stuck with the one person whom you hate most in this whole wide world...
en: Or the misery of being stuck with the one person whom you hate most in this whole wide world...
ja: あるいは、この広い世界で最も憎む相手と一緒に閉じ込められる惨めさであれ…

key: These things belong to you.
en: These things belong to you.
ja: それらはあなた自身のもの。

key: Darkness is not to blame, should you find them there.
en: Darkness is not to blame, should you find them there.
ja: たとえそこに見出したとしても、闇に責はない。

key: They were always with you anyway.
en: They were always with you anyway.
ja: それらはどのみち、いつもあなたとともにあった。

key: Everyone is always with you.
en: Everyone is always with you.
ja: 誰もが、いつもあなたとともにある。

key: Do not fear, hero of this chapter.
en: Do not fear, hero of this chapter.
ja: 恐れるな、この章の英雄よ。

key: I shall see to it that the Master is cared for here, too.
en: I shall see to it that the Master is cared for here, too.
ja: この場所でも、マスターの世話は私が見届けよう。

key: But this door is closed to you.
en: But this door is closed to you.
ja: だが、この扉はあなたには閉ざされている。

key: It is not yours to visit any longer.
en: It is not yours to visit any longer.
ja: もう、あなたが訪れるべき場所ではない。

key: Be at peace, and try again what you know you must.
en: Be at peace, and try again what you know you must.
ja: 安らかにあれ、そして、なすべきだとわかっていることを再び試みよ。

key: No one is as lucky as us.
en: No one is as lucky as us.
ja: 誰も、わたしたちほど幸運じゃない。

key: We're not at the end, but, oh! We've already won.
en: We're not at the end, but, oh! We've already won.
ja: まだ終わりじゃないけど、ああ! もうわたしたちは勝ってる。

key: An old area map is posted here.
en: An old area map is posted here.
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている。

key: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
en: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
ja: 長い間、誰も手をつけていないようだ。
